svg.data-weight-note: not stated, the two documents that give a weight disagree (gap `weight`)
svg.data-power-input: external AC/DC power adapter, 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz in, 12 VDC out (data sheet)
svg.data-power-usage: typical 6.2 W (0.13 A) at 120 VAC and 7 W (0.10 A) at 240 VAC; maximum 28 W at both (data sheet)
svg.data-cpu: Dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 MPCore with CoreSight
svg.data-serial-pinout: automatic Cyclades and Cisco pin-out detection (data sheet)
svg.data-sensor-ports: environmental sensor port (RJ45, 1-wire) and a digital in port (installer guide)
svg.data-digital-out: two relay switches on one four-pin connector, 12 A and 300 V (installer guide)
svg.data-certification: Emissions and immunity: FCC Class A, CE Class A, UKCA, ICES-003, VCCI, RCM, Customs Union, KCC. Safety: UL, cUL, EN-60950, CB, Customs Union (data sheet).
